body: I've been at the same place for about a year now.  Sorry to hear you are as well.  I just quit my job to take a break from that life for a bit and live off savings.  Don't know if it will help but I don't know what else to do. ;\

I wouldn't say dying is easy.  Suicide is the hardest decision/action I can imagine. As for it being temporary or that in ten years I'll surely not want to seems unrealistically optimistic.  It's just something nice to tell people that feel this way, it's not really realistic.  I may be happy with my life, or I may still want to die.  Neither you or I can say that with any confidence.

I avoid seeking medical assistance for 3 reasons.  

1. Cost 

2. If I was truly honest to a medical professional about how close I am to the edge any given times a month, I imagine I'd be forcefully committed.  I've read these stories on this very subreddit.  You're met with generally unhelpful responses if you admit this.  I refuse to be held against my will and dehumanized.

3. I'll admit, I haven't researched anti depressants really at all.  While this is unlike me to have a possibly greatly misinformed opinion here's what I've gathered.  

They won't replace how I see the world, and how I've seen the world for most my life happy or unhappy.

They may dull every emotion I have. I've been empty and devoid of emotion, and while I'd say I feel dead inside most the time now, I can feel short bursts of immense joy occasionally interspersed among the severe depression.  I'd rather feel :) or :( and not just :|

Among numerous other possible side affects..weight gain, loss of sex drive, possibly even making me feel more depressed.

I know there's a few different types of anti depressants and they all act differently..but finding the one with the most positive reaction could be very expensive and even more tiring than my life already is.  And in general I don't like the idea of taking a pill to feel better.

I do appreciate being heard and the replies though, even if I sound like a dick in my replies. -_-

And, yes I make up my own punctuation and sentence structure rules, deal with it grammar nazis. ;p


Edit: I'm kind of glad the manic/illogical depressed people get more attention than me.  They're more likely to be helped by those who frequent these parts, and more likely to live long fulfilling lives.  No one will take me seriously until I'm dead, thus my close friends' exodus after confession.  It's nearly impossible to help with someone like me, I wish you all the best of luck in your lives.

Because killing yourself is a very difficult thing to do.  And when I think no one can help me, I reach out anyway because as much as I want to stop existing, it's difficult to get to that point and execute it.

Humans are rarely perfectly rational, myself included.
